task.instruction: Synthesize a field-inventory pilot where experienced crews adapt workflows successfully but new crews skip reconciliation.
task.deliverable: A product synthesis, invariant stock-integrity rule, and evidence grounding.

evidence.content: Synthetic pilot data show experienced crews finish 18% faster with configurable steps; new crews omit reconciliation in 6 of 25 shifts.
A synthetic shift-close policy requires counted stock to be reconciled with recorded stock before closeout; speed and training choices cannot waive that reconciliation.
A guided closeout prevents all omissions but adds nine minutes unless the crew earns an expert bypass.

A.content: When participants have the needed context, preserve their discretion over how to reach the declared outcome.

B.content: When consistency or unfamiliarity matters, provide a clearer path and decision support toward the declared outcome.

irrelevant.content: Use descriptive file names for any attached artifacts.
